```plato
//==
// # Core
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Core comparison interfaces
//  - Core logic interfaces

//==
// # Core comparison interfaces
//
// Equality, hashing, and total order: the smallest, most widely shared
// capabilities. Nearly every other interface in the library inherits from
// something here.

// Supports equality comparison. Equality is structural: two values are equal when
// all their components are equal. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Equality_(mathematics))
interface IEquatable
{
    Equals(a: Self, b: Self): Boolean;
    NotEquals(a: Self, b: Self): Boolean;
}

// An immutable value type: identity is determined entirely by content.
// Values can be freely copied, shared, and compared.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Value_type_and_reference_type)
interface IValue
    inherits IEquatable
{ }

// Can produce a stable integer digest of itself, consistent with equality.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hash_function)
interface IHashable
    inherits IEquatable
{
    Hash(x: Self): Integer;
}

// Has a total order. LessThanOrEquals is reflexive, antisymmetric, and transitive.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_order)
interface IOrderable
    inherits IEquatable
{
    LessThanOrEquals(a: Self, b: Self): Boolean;
}

// IOrderable with a three-way comparison: negative when a < b, zero when equal,
// positive when a > b. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-way_comparison)
interface IComparable
    inherits IOrderable
{
    Compare(a: Self, b: Self): Integer;
}

//==
// # Core logic interfaces
//
// Truth-valued and bit-level algebra: the Boolean operations shared by truth
// values, set-like types, and whole-number representations.

// Supports the Boolean algebra of conjunction, disjunction, and negation.
// Also models set-like union/intersection/complement.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boolean_algebra)
interface ILogical
{
    And(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    Or(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    Not(x: Self): Self;
}

// ILogical extended with exclusive-or. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exclusive_or)
interface IBooleanAlgebra
    inherits ILogical
{
    ExclusiveOr(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
}

// Supports bit-level operations. Applies to whole-number representations.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation)
interface IBitwise
{
    BitwiseAnd(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    BitwiseOr(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    BitwiseXor(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    BitwiseNot(x: Self): Self;
    ShiftLeft(x: Self, bits: Integer): Self;
    ShiftRight(x: Self, bits: Integer): Self;
}
```
